components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-confidence conversion action for demos and primary route actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.85rem 2rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-primary-light)); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.01em; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(27, 77, 92, 0.3); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(27, 77, 92, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary light-surface action that becomes teal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.85rem 2rem; border: 1px solid rgba(27, 77, 92, 0.28); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary); font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(27, 77, 92, 0.2); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gold Badge
components.description: Compact gold emphasis badge for COD, value, and highlighted status labels.
components.css: .ds-badge-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent-light); color: var(--color-accent-contrast); font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Default Card
components.description: Rounded marketing content surface with soft operational lift.
components.html:
Smart dispatch

Assign shipments to couriers by location, load, and priority.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: var(--color-text); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 2rem 1.75rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(27, 77, 92, 0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(27, 77, 92, 0.04); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(27, 77, 92, 0.08); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Accessible white field for tracking, contact, and demo forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-body); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 1rem; background: #fff; color: var(--color-text); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-secondary); opacity: 0.8; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(27, 77, 92, 0.12); }

components.name: Dark Navigation
components.description: Sticky command-surface navigation for the public marketing site.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 1.5rem; background: rgba(15, 51, 64, 0.92); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-heading); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); } .ds-nav strong { margin-inline-end: auto; font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav a { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: #fff; } .ds-nav button { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-primary-light)); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-heading); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Trackora's visual system should feel like a reliable logistics record brought to life: every shipment, courier, risk signal, and COD movement has a visible place. The design uses deep teal as the trust anchor, warm gold as the action signal, rounded tactile controls, and dashboard-like surfaces that make delivery operations feel organized rather than abstract.
keyCharacteristics: Arabic-first operational clarity with bilingual parity.
Teal-dominant surfaces with gold action emphasis.
Tactile pill controls, rounded product surfaces, and clear focus states.
Lifted cards and glow used to separate operational layers.
Motion that supports status, reveal, and affordance without hiding content.

rules.name: The Gold Is an Action Rule
rules.body: Gold is reserved for action, status, COD/value emphasis, and focus. Do not scatter it as decoration.

rules.name: The Teal Carries Trust Rule
rules.body: High-value claims, navigation, and product-control surfaces should lean on Operational Teal or Deep Command Teal before introducing new hues.

rules.name: The Arabic First Rule
rules.body: New components should inherit Arabic typography and RTL behavior by default, then adapt cleanly to English through the existing locale switches.

rules.name: The No Editorial Costume Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce serif display, mono metadata, drop caps, or magazine-like separators unless the product context explicitly changes.

rules.name: The Lift Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Elevation must separate an interactive or operational layer. If the shadow does not clarify state, hierarchy, or focus, remove it.

dos: Do use teal as the trust anchor for major surfaces, CTAs, navigation, and product-control moments.
Do keep Arabic-first typography and RTL layout native, not patched after English layouts are complete.
Do use gold for focus, action, COD/value emphasis, and status emphasis, especially where the user can do something next.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion fallbacks on every interactive or animated element.
Do show operational proof: shipments, couriers, COD, dispatch, tracking, validation, and risk states.
donts: Don't let Trackora look like a generic SaaS template: repetitive icon-card grids, decorative gradient text, interchangeable dashboard mockups, vague buzzwords, tiny repeated section eyebrows, or muted text that reads poorly on tinted backgrounds.
Don't use gradient text as emphasis. Use a solid token color, weight, or hierarchy instead.
Don't use glass, blur, or glow as decoration. Use them only when they clarify layered command surfaces.
Don't add side-stripe borders greater than 1px on cards, callouts, or list items.
Don't introduce new fonts, serif editorial styling, or monospace technical costume without a confirmed design-system change.
